column4: The Women’s Ministry at Messiah Fellowship provides a meaningful space for women to grow in faith, build relationships, and encourage one another in their walk with God.
column5: The Youth Ministry at Messiah Fellowship is a place where young people can grow in faith, build lasting friendships, and discover God’s purpose for their lives.

column4: We meet on the second Tuesday of every month, creating a time of fellowship, prayer, and spiritual enrichment. These gatherings are designed to strengthen women through the Word of God and help them grow deeper in their relationship with Christ.
column5: We meet every second Saturday at 6:00pm for worship, Bible teaching, prayer, and fellowship. These gatherings help young people build a strong foundation in God’s Word and a personal relationship with Jesus Christ.

column4: Women of all ages and backgrounds come together to share life, support one another, and learn how to apply biblical principles in everyday living. Through worship, teaching, and fellowship, the ministry nurtures spiritual growth and unity.
column5: Students and young professionals from all backgrounds come together to encourage one another, ask honest questions, and learn how to apply biblical principles to everyday life, studies, and careers.

column4: This ministry also focuses on practical aspects of life, helping women grow in faith, family, and purpose, while encouraging them to live confidently in God’s calling.
column5: Our goal is to raise a generation rooted in Christ and bold in faith, equipped to lead, serve others, and make a lasting impact in their families, church, and communities.
